newsitem.title: FRANCE: France says no decision yet on France Telecom.
newsitem.headline: France says no decision yet on France Telecom.

text.p: The French Finance Ministry said on Thursday the government had not taken any decision yet on whether to sell a minority stake in France Telecom.
"No decision has been taken. We await the report by Michel Delebarre," a spokesman for the Finance Ministry said.
Earlier on Thursday an official source told Reuters the sale of a minority stake in France Telecom could start in September as soon as the Delebarre report was handed to the government.
Delebarre was appointed on July 17 to lead a wide consultation with France Telecom staff and management about the future of the company and report back to the government by September 5.
Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said in the mission letter to Delebarre that the state would keep a majority stake in the company.
